name: open-computer-use-windows
description: Visual-first Windows Computer Use MCP that observes real screenshots and sends native input events.

interface.longDescription: Uses real Windows screenshots as the UI source of truth, renders a visible virtual cursor, and sends native mouse, keyboard, and scroll events without reading DOM or UI Automation trees.
defaultPrompt: Call observe_screen before acting and treat the latest screenshot as the UI source of truth
Use activate_application to bring the requested application forward instead of asking the user to switch it manually
Call move_mouse and visually verify the virtual cursor hotspot before every click
Verify the fresh screenshot returned after every action before continuing

permissions.reason: Launch the installed Visual Computer Use stdio MCP executable.
Send user-requested native mouse, keyboard, and scroll events to Windows applications.
